Paper: 3DGStream: On-the-Fly Training of 3D Gaussians for Efficient Streaming of Photo-Realistic Free-Viewpoint Videos

Section: Neural Transformation Cache

Content:
The multi-resolution hash encoding addresses all our requirements for the NTC: • Compactness: Hashing effectively reduces the storage space needed for encoding the whole scene.
• Efficiency: Hash table lookup operates in O(1), and is highly compatible with modern GPUs.
• Adaptivity: Hash collisions occur in hash tables at finer resolutions, allowing regions with larger gradients-representing dynamic regions in our context-to drive the optimization. • Priors: The combination of linear interpolation and the voxel-grid structure ensures the local smoothness of transformations. Additionally, the multi-resolution approach adeptly merges global and local information. Furthermore, to enhance the NTC's performance with minimal overhead, we utilize a shallow fully-fused MLP[38]. This maps the hash encoding to a 7-dimensional output: the first three dimensions indicate the translation of the 3DG; the remaining dimensions represent the rotation of the 3DG using quaternions.
